notes.title: LIP! Lewd Idol Project: A Second Chance Campaign Launches on Indiegogo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41596189/24af66e8cb12bc86b84a0895f34c1502b38aa0ed.jpg[/img]

A new crowdfunding campaign has begun on Indiegogo to raise funding to complete LIP! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 2, 3 and their associated DLC contents. Originally funded on Kickstarter in 2020, funds for the project were unfortunately frozen by Paypal which brought development on the remaining games to a standstill. This is a new opportunity to not only raise the funds necessary to finish the campaign but to also introduce new fans to Kairi and her friends in this lewd visual novel adventure about idols doing idol things!

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/lip-lewd-idol-project-a-second-chance--2#/]LIP! Lewd Idol Project: A Second Chance Indiegogo Campaign Page[/url]

For more information about this campaign, be sure to read the FAQ which lays out how funds will be allocated as well as information for backers of the Kickstarter campaign.

[url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/lip-lewd-idol-project-a-second-chance--2#/faq]LIP! Lewd Idol Project: A Second Chance FAQ[/url]
